Here is your form (your application only). Before the fields, one urgent point:

**Your daughter's passport expires on 1 January 2027, before your 20 April 2027 arrival.** Japan will not issue her a visa on it. She needs a new passport before her own application. Once she has it, her passport number, issue date and expiry date will all change, so the values stored for her will need updating too. Your passport (valid to 4 June 2029) and your wife's (valid to 10 August 2030) are fine.

Still needed from you: other names, other nationalities, government ID number, passport type, place of issue, flight, hotel, email, employer details, guarantor/inviter (or "None"), the six background questions, and the application date.

Your wife and daughter each need their own form. When you fill those, B32 asks for the partner's occupation (yours, Software Engineer, on your wife's form). For your daughter, as a minor, it asks for both parents' occupations.
